summary: Our project is an interactive educational website that takes students on an exciting journey through the Solar System. It combines interesting space information with quizzes, multiple-choice questions, true or false challenges, and question-and-answer activities. Instead of simply reading facts, users can explore, interact, and test their knowledge. We aim to turn learning about space into a fun and engaging experience using the digital tools and creative abilities available to our team.
details:
Our project is a interactive learning games website to make exploring the Solar System more exciting and interactive. It introduces users to the Sun, planets, and different space objects through organized and easy-to-understand information.

To make the experience more engaging, we include multiple-choice questions, true or false challenges, and question-and-answer activities. These features help users test their knowledge, review information, and learn through participation.

What makes our project special is the combination of science, creativity, and interaction. Rather than building a website that only displays information, we want to create an enjoyable learning experience that encourages exploration and curiosity.

We will develop the website using accessible digital tools and the capabilities available to our team, focusing on visual design, content organization, and interactive features without relying on writing programming code from scratch. We will also use AI assistance to support idea development and organize educational content.
